title: CAPTCHA not showing on my contact form
author: example-user
body:
### Plugin version
1.0.0

### Craft version
5.8.2

### PHP version
8.3

### What happened?
The form has hCaptcha turned on in Basin but no CAPTCHA appears on the page. The form submits and Basin rejects it as spam. Our site sends a Content-Security-Policy header from nginx. Is there something I need to add?
